droppedMetadata: Registration-sheet metadata is identity-matched to a profileId in registration-metadata.json. Most of it (contact/background/agreements) has a real column on `profile` now and import-school.ts's `data` command backfills it there. The rest (qualified status, upanayanam, reference contacts, consent flags, etc.) still has no home in the schema and is dropped by the importer, kept here only for whenever that changes.
